title: 视 界
subtitle: 一次关于时间的坠落

subtitles.text: 它自己不发光。
subtitles.timing_method: 6% peak white-text pixel count at 60fps; fade-inclusive estimate

subtitles.text: 我们看到的，是它周围被弯折的光。
subtitles.timing_method: 6% peak white-text pixel count at 60fps; fade-inclusive estimate

subtitles.text: 质量约为十万个太阳，视界半径约三十万千米。
subtitles.timing_method: 6% peak white-text pixel count at 60fps; fade-inclusive estimate

subtitles.text: 光要走整整一秒，才能跨过它的半径。
subtitles.timing_method: 6% peak white-text pixel count at 60fps; fade-inclusive estimate

subtitles.text: 吸积盘的内缘，气体以一半光速绕行。
subtitles.timing_method: 6% peak white-text pixel count at 60fps; fade-inclusive estimate

subtitles.text: 迎面而来的一侧更亮、更蓝；远去的一侧更暗、更红。
subtitles.timing_method: 6% peak white-text pixel count at 60fps; fade-inclusive estimate

subtitles.text: 盘的背面，被引力弯折到了黑洞的上方和下方。
subtitles.timing_method: 6% peak white-text pixel count at 60fps; fade-inclusive estimate

subtitles.text: 母船悬停在12倍视界半径处。
subtitles.timing_method: 6% peak white-text pixel count at 60fps; fade-inclusive estimate

subtitles.text: 我们放下一枚探测器。它的信标每秒闪一次。
subtitles.timing_method: 6% peak white-text pixel count at 60fps; fade-inclusive estimate

subtitles.text: 起初，它的闪光和母船的时钟同步。
subtitles.timing_method: 6% peak white-text pixel count at 60fps; fade-inclusive estimate

subtitles.text: 闪光的间隔，正在一点点变长。
subtitles.timing_method: 6% peak white-text pixel count at 60fps; fade-inclusive estimate

subtitles.text: 它的光越来越红，也越来越暗。
subtitles.timing_method: 6% peak white-text pixel count at 60fps; fade-inclusive estimate

subtitles.text: 在母船看来，它的时间几乎停住了。
subtitles.timing_method: 6% peak white-text pixel count at 60fps; fade-inclusive estimate

subtitles.text: 它将永远停在视界之外，慢慢熄灭。
subtitles.timing_method: 6% peak white-text pixel count at 60fps; fade-inclusive estimate

subtitles.text: 但这只是我们看到的。
subtitles.timing_method: 6% peak white-text pixel count at 60fps; fade-inclusive estimate

subtitles.text: 探测器上，时间照常流逝。
subtitles.timing_method: 6% peak white-text pixel count at 60fps; fade-inclusive estimate

subtitles.text: 每一秒，依然是一秒。
subtitles.timing_method: 6% peak white-text pixel count at 60fps; fade-inclusive estimate

subtitles.text: 回望母船，它的时钟也慢了下来，但最多只慢到一半。
subtitles.timing_method: 6% peak white-text pixel count at 60fps; fade-inclusive estimate

subtitles.text: 视界没有任何标记。
subtitles.timing_method: 6% peak white-text pixel count at 60fps; fade-inclusive estimate

subtitles.text: 越过它的那一刻，探测器没有察觉任何异样。
subtitles.timing_method: 6% peak white-text pixel count at 60fps; fade-inclusive estimate

subtitles.text: 探测器早已越过了视界。
subtitles.timing_method: 6% peak white-text pixel count at 60fps; fade-inclusive estimate

subtitles.text: 而那一刻发出的光，永远到不了母船。
subtitles.timing_method: 6% peak white-text pixel count at 60fps; fade-inclusive estimate
